## Data Wrangling

### Load Required Libraries
```{r load_packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(forecast)
library(tseries)
library(ggplot2)
library(urca)
library(TSA)
library(dplyr)
```

### Assess the Data
The data we will be using for this session is Lake Huron data that is available natively in R.

```{r load_dataset}
lakehuron <- LakeHuron
dplyr::glimpse(lakehuron)
```
